contract.intent: Produce the system-design doc for Ann (type system-design): components & ownership, data model, boundaries/interfaces, failure modes, scale assumptions — the technique layer, built on the locked spec + format v2.
acceptanceCriteria: Components listed, each with a one-line job and an owner (what does each component refuse to do?)
Data model defined: StepNode, artifacts, checkpoints, trace — who writes, who reads, stale-read behavior, empty-record decision
Shared schemas frozen at interfaces (StepNode JSON schema, context packet schema, binding API)
Failure modes per component: fail-closed vs fail-open explicit; the one failure that would wreck the product named
Scale assumptions stated (tree size, write rate, fixture suite size)
Q1-Q4 resolved or explicitly parked with defaults (runtime, provider, storage, UI)
